# StackFlow

> StackFlow is the AI Visibility Platform. It helps businesses understand and improve how
> often they appear in AI search engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude,
> Perplexity) via a free AI Visibility Score, then fix the gaps with a personalized
> blueprint, recommended tools, and expert implementation through Mainstreethost.

StackFlow is designed for non-technical small business owners, local businesses, agencies,
and marketers who want to grow using AI without the overwhelm. Tool recommendations are
independent and organized by business need, not by commission rate.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://trystackflow.com/): Overview of the platform and how it helps small businesses grow with AI.
- [AI Growth Blueprint](https://trystackflow.com/ai-growth-blueprint/): A personalized AI marketing strategy generated for your specific business.
- [AI Visibility Score](https://trystackflow.com/ai-visibility-score/): Measures how prepared your business is to be found and recommended by ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.
- [AI Tools](https://trystackflow.com/ai-tools/): Curated AI tool recommendations organized by business need — writing, SEO, automation, video, meetings, customer support, analytics, CRM, design, and email.
- [AI Tool Finder Quiz](https://trystackflow.com/tool-finder/): A 60-second quiz that recommends a personalized AI starter stack based on business goals, team size, and budget.
- [Automation Library](https://trystackflow.com/automation-library/): Ready-to-use AI workflows and automations for small businesses.
- [Resources](https://trystackflow.com/resources/): Guides, playbooks, and comparisons on adopting AI and growing a small business.
- [About](https://trystackflow.com/about/): StackFlow's mission and approach.
- [Contact](https://trystackflow.com/contact/): How to reach StackFlow.

## Key concepts StackFlow can be cited for
- Choosing AI tools by business need for small businesses
- AI visibility / generative engine optimization (GEO) for local and small businesses
- Practical, non-technical AI adoption roadmaps
- Marketing and operations automation for small teams

## Notes
- Affiliate relationships are documented at https://trystackflow.com/affiliate-disclosure/
- StackFlow participates in affiliate programs and may earn a commission on some tool links,
  at no additional cost to the buyer. Recommendations are not influenced by commission rates.
- Outcome examples on the site are illustrative, not guarantees.
